decisions.label: N0 TNM Finding
decisions.description: A regional lymph node TNM finding indicating that there is no evidence of regional lymph node metastasis.

verification.note: NCIT:C48705 N0 TNM Finding; generic N-category TNM finding for absence of lymph node metastasis. Label differs (N0 vs N0 TNM Finding) but is the correct NCIT concept.

decisions.label: N1 TNM Finding
decisions.description: A regional lymph node TNM finding indicating cancer metastasis in a limited number of regional lymph nodes; the specific meaning depends on cancer type.

verification.note: NCIT:C48706 N1 TNM Finding; generic N1 category. Label differs (N1 vs N1 TNM Finding) but is the correct NCIT concept.

decisions.label: N1a TNM Finding
decisions.description: A regional lymph node TNM finding of cancer metastasis in a limited number of lymph nodes; the specific meaning depends on cancer type.

verification.note: NCIT:C48707 N1a TNM Finding; generic N1a subcategory. Label differs (N1a vs N1a TNM Finding) but is the correct NCIT concept.

decisions.label: N1b TNM Finding
decisions.description: A regional lymph node TNM finding of cancer metastasis; the specific meaning depends on cancer type.

verification.note: NCIT:C48708 N1b TNM Finding; generic N1b subcategory.

decisions.label: N1bI Stage Finding
decisions.description: A regional lymph node TNM finding indicating metastasis to 1-3 nodes, each greater than 2 mm and less than 20 mm.

verification.note: NCIT:C95929 N1bI Stage Finding; label uses 'Stage Finding' suffix vs the plain N1bI notation, but is the correct NCIT concept for this subcategory.

decisions.label: N1bII Stage Finding
decisions.description: A regional lymph node TNM finding indicating metastasis to four or more nodes, each greater than 2 mm and less than 20 mm.

verification.note: NCIT:C95935 N1bII Stage Finding; correct NCIT concept for this subcategory.

decisions.label: N1bIII Stage Finding
decisions.description: A regional lymph node TNM finding indicating tumor extension beyond the lymph node capsule, with metastasis less than 20 mm.

verification.note: NCIT:C95936 N1bIII Stage Finding; correct NCIT concept for this subcategory.

decisions.label: N1bIV Stage Finding
decisions.description: A regional lymph node TNM finding indicating lymph node metastases greater than 20 mm.

verification.note: NCIT:C95937 N1bIV Stage Finding; correct NCIT concept for this subcategory.

decisions.label: N1c TNM Finding
decisions.description: A regional lymph node TNM finding of cancer metastasis; the specific meaning depends on cancer type.

verification.note: NCIT:C48709 N1c TNM Finding; generic N1c subcategory.

decisions.label: N2 TNM Finding
decisions.description: A regional lymph node TNM finding of cancer metastasis in several regional lymph nodes; the specific meaning depends on cancer type.

verification.note: NCIT:C48786 N2 TNM Finding; generic N2 category.

decisions.label: N2a TNM Finding
decisions.description: A regional lymph node TNM finding of cancer metastasis in several lymph nodes; the specific meaning depends on cancer type.

verification.note: NCIT:C48711 N2a TNM Finding; generic N2a subcategory.

decisions.label: N2b TNM Finding
decisions.description: A regional lymph node TNM finding of cancer metastasis in several lymph nodes; the specific meaning depends on cancer type.

verification.note: NCIT:C48712 N2b TNM Finding; generic N2b subcategory.

decisions.label: N2c TNM Finding
decisions.description: A regional lymph node TNM finding of cancer metastasis in several lymph nodes; the specific meaning depends on cancer type.

verification.note: NCIT:C48713 N2c TNM Finding; generic N2c subcategory.

decisions.label: N3 TNM Finding
decisions.description: A regional lymph node TNM finding of cancer metastasis in multiple lymph nodes; the specific meaning depends on cancer type.

verification.note: NCIT:C48714 N3 TNM Finding; generic N3 category.

decisions.label: N3a TNM Finding
decisions.description: A regional lymph node TNM finding of cancer metastasis in multiple lymph nodes; the specific meaning depends on cancer type.

verification.note: NCIT:C48715 N3a TNM Finding; generic N3a subcategory.

decisions.label: N3b TNM Finding
decisions.description: A regional lymph node TNM finding of cancer metastasis in multiple lymph nodes; the specific meaning depends on cancer type.

verification.note: NCIT:C48716 N3b TNM Finding; generic N3b subcategory.

decisions.label: N3c TNM Finding
decisions.description: A regional lymph node TNM finding of cancer metastasis in multiple lymph nodes; the specific meaning depends on cancer type.

verification.note: NCIT:C48717 N3c TNM Finding; generic N3c subcategory.

decisions.label: N4 TNM Finding
decisions.description: A regional lymph node TNM finding of cancer metastasis in multiple lymph nodes; the specific meaning depends on cancer type.

verification.note: NCIT:C96026 N4 TNM Finding; generic N4 category used by some cancer types (e.g., ocular adnexal lymphoma).

decisions.label: NX TNM Finding
decisions.description: A regional lymph node TNM finding indicating that the status of regional lymph nodes cannot be assessed.

verification.note: NCIT:C48718 NX TNM Finding; correct concept for unassessable lymph node status.

decisions.label: Unknown
decisions.description: Not known, observed, recorded, or reported as unknown by the data contributor.

verification.note: NCIT:C17998 Unknown; standard NCIT qualifier.

decisions.label: Not Reported
decisions.description: An indication that the required information was not provided.

verification.note: NCIT:C43234 Not Reported; standard NCIT qualifier.
